metadata.description: Hero Media's shared skills for Claude Code and the Claude app.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Frontend and web design: avoid generic AI-looking interfaces and build pages with a clear visual direction.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Find and install new skills from the open skills ecosystem (via npx skills). Claude Code only.

plugins.name: hero-media
plugins.description: Hero Media's own skills. client-context gives Claude each client's context from Google Drive, in both the Claude app and Claude Code. Install this for everyone.

plugins.name: marketing-ads
plugins.description: Paid acquisition and measurement: ad campaigns, ad creative, analytics tracking and A/B testing.

plugins.name: marketing-content
plugins.description: Content and copy: copywriting, copy editing, content strategy, social, video, images, lead magnets, free tools, community, PR and co-marketing.

plugins.name: marketing-conversion
plugins.description: Conversion and retention: CRO, signup and onboarding flows, paywalls, popups, lifecycle email and SMS, referrals and churn prevention.

plugins.name: marketing-sales
plugins.description: Sales and outbound: prospecting, cold email, sales enablement and RevOps.

plugins.name: marketing-seo
plugins.description: Search visibility: SEO audits, AI search (AEO/GEO), programmatic SEO, schema markup, site architecture, comparison pages, directory submissions and app store optimization.

plugins.name: marketing-strategy
plugins.description: Marketing strategy and positioning: product-marketing context, marketing plans, ideas, customer research, competitor profiles, pricing, offers and launches. Install this first; the other marketing plugins read the product-marketing context it creates.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Security audit of a codebase using isolated agents, from reconnaissance to verified findings and a report. From Cloudflare.
